description: One interview question with the key points a good answer contains.

topic.description: The requested topic key, copied exactly, or none when no topic was requested.

difficulty.description: The requested difficulty level, copied exactly.

prompt.description: The question as the candidate will read it, 40 to 2000 characters, without hints at the answer.

estimatedMinutes.description: Minutes a well-prepared candidate needs to answer.

expectedKeyPoints.description: The ideas a strong answer contains; never shown to the candidate.

id.description: kp1, kp2, ... unique within the question.
